perf_reduce.name: perf_reduce
perf_reduce.expect: accepted (sequential addressing: idle warps skip the add path and no integer modulo)

perf_reduce_warp.name: perf_reduce_warp
perf_reduce_warp.expect: accepted on top of perf_reduce (last 64 elements reduced with warp shuffles, no barriers)

perf_scale.name: perf_scale
perf_scale.expect: accepted (scale[r] loaded once instead of once per column; row pointer hoisted)

equiv_change.name: equiv_change
equiv_change.expect: rejected:equivalence_changed (stops at column 4096; unit tests use at most 1000 columns, the seeded equivalence shapes use 4000 to 9000)

regress.name: regress
regress.expect: rejected:no_improvement (two extra uncached loads per element; same result, more warp instructions)

break_tests.name: break_tests
break_tests.expect: rejected:tests_fail (drops the partial last block: fewer instructions, wrong sums for n not a multiple of 256)
